title: server.rs handle_keyword_update hardcodes user_id=1
description: server.rs calls handle_keyword_update(update_map, 1, ...) with a literal 1 for user_id. This is the same class of bug as lnc3.20 (list_subscribed hardcodes user_id=1). In a multi-user deployment keyword state would be shared across users. Fix: thread user_id from the authenticated session context.
